notes: Diagram-only pass: added 16 bank SVGs + opener + 2 teach-walk SVGs (19 figures). No question text, solutions, guided steps, hints or misconceptions were changed. All figures generated programmatically from each problem's own numbers; every label cross-checked against the problem text and re-verified in a rendered browser preview. Theme-safe throughout: text and strokes use currentColor, the two filled shapes (gold[3]) use soft #60a5fa/#34d399 at fill-opacity 0.28, no external refs. 'Diagram not drawn accurately' caption on every not-to-scale figure; omitted on the regular polygons and the geometrically exact vertex/parallel figures. Three figures were corrected before ship so the drawn angle matches its label: opener (120 label moved onto the wide wedge), bronze[0] (ray redrawn at true 72), bronze[5] (transversal re-sloped to true 70 so the co-interior pair reads 110/70 rather than 59/121). Skipped figures on the pure count-from-a-formula problems where n is the unknown (gold[0] interior 162, gold[2] sum 1620, silver[2] exterior 40, silver[5] interior 108): drawing them would either reveal the answer or show nothing the text does not already state. Validator PASS; PATCH 204; live roundtrip confirms 16 bank + opener + 2 teach SVGs.
